focus: Charter item 2: help fix the issues the platform finds. Executive report issues become a durable target-level fix plan whose items carry machine-verifiable criteria; re-inspections verify each item automatically, so fix status changes only through observation, never assertion.
reason_generation_started: Ferosh routed the post-GEN-014 priorities as fix-assist first, then the smaller refinements (facet curation, rendered mobile, maturity enforcement), then non-Shopify adapter groundwork.
primary_deliverable: Fix plan artifact per target (assessments/<target>/fix-plan.json) with typed items, Shopify implementation guidance, verification criteria, and history; dashboard panel with Generate/Update Fix Plan and Verify Against This Run; automatic status transitions open -> verified_fixed / still_failing / regressed.
scope_notes: Issue classification covers the generator's issue types: zero-result queries, failed queries, slow queries, unassisted prefixes, invisible dropdowns (per query), and rendered pages without products.
Verification matches on query text so curated query-pack evolution does not orphan plan items; unmatched items record not_checked history instead of guessing.
Items verified fixed that reappear as issues are marked regressed, preserving the full history.
The executive report generator now emits per-query invisible-dropdown findings when some dropdowns render and others do not.
validation_notes: VAL-059 validates the first fix-assist slice.
Live Pink Lily proof: two real invisible-dropdown findings became fix plan items; verification against the current run honestly reports both still_failing with observed values.
Temp-root API tests prove the full transition: issue -> open item -> still_failing against unfixed evidence -> verified_fixed against fixed evidence, with history recorded.
VAL-060 validates the one-click live verification slice (bounded re-inspection of only affected surfaces plus automatic verification).

VAL-061 is the second independent clean pass: Dress Up rerun with full parity, fix-verification determinism, clean suites, and BDD-INV-005 (35 BDDs, 33 passing, 0 failing). Phase exit declared 2026-07-15.
known_gaps_opened: Fix plan items are per-query; systemic findings (for example sitewide latency) have no aggregate item type yet.
Live verification reuses the standard inspection runner with --only plugin selection; a still-cheaper single-query probe mode remains possible future work.
Fix guidance is static Shopify text; guided in-app remediation steps are a future slice.
Priorities after fix-assist per operator routing: facet-attribute curation (DS3), rendered mobile capture, decision-3A enforcement at onboarding, then non-Shopify adapter groundwork.
